title: Little Go
tagline: A small board. A quiet game for the whole family.
taglineZh: 一张小棋盘，一家人安静下一局。

lines.zh: 八十一个交叉点，黑棋先行。

lines.en: Little Go. A small board, a quiet game for the whole family.
lines.zh: 小围棋。一张小棋盘，一家人安静下一局。

lines.en: Place stones, surround ground, and capture groups without liberties.
lines.zh: 落子、围地，提掉没有气的棋。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to a 200-playout Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到 200 次推演的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Undo, a hint with a reason, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 悔棋、带理由的提示、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: White gets 6.5 komi. Two passes end the game and the board shows the count.
lines.zh: 白棋贴 6.5 目。双方连续停一手，棋盘直接标出数子结果。

lines.en: Little Go. A quiet game for Family Arcade.
lines.zh: 小围棋。Family Arcade 的一局安静棋。
